justification: Changes how the copier labels rules and when it writes; it re-wrote 53 production rows. Nothing on the site reads the quote columns yet, so not Critical.

pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: A chapter PDF that cannot be downloaded now leaves stored verdicts untouched and makes --apply exit 1
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Re-judged the 53 rows the changes affect (figure_caption + label_bounded) with --apply --ids

functions.name: figure_kind
functions.output: figure_legend, figure_caption or None for a real rule
functions.if_none: empty body never matches the figure pattern, returns None

functions.name: write
functions.input: list of judge result dicts for served rules
functions.output: UPDATE of quote columns per chapter, skipping unreadable PDFs
functions.if_none: empty list stores nothing and the count check reports it

queries.where_clause: rp.id = v.id AND md5(rp.provision_text) = v.md5 AND rp.is_current AND active registry path = judged path
queries.if_wrong: primary key, one row per value

break_it.scenario: An R2 download fails during a scheduled --apply
break_it.what_happens: good exact quotes would be overwritten as unconfirmed
break_it.repro: run --apply with R2 credentials unset for one chapter

break_it.scenario: A real rule starts with a figure title
break_it.what_happens: marked not_a_control, so the council's rule would be hidden
break_it.how: figure_kind: only legends and captions of 25 words or fewer

break_it.scenario: Label-bounded copy stopped by the 40-line cap
break_it.what_happens: a control cut short shown as recovered
break_it.how: copy_from_label returns None unless the council's next label (or document end) bounds it

break_it.scenario: A rule's text or its chapter PDF changes between judging and storing
break_it.what_happens: a verdict judged on old text or an old PDF would be stored against the new one
break_it.how: council_quote_db.write matches md5(provision_text) and the chapter's active r2_current_path; unmatched rows stay NULL and the count check exits 1

falsifiable_check.fails_when: a figure-titled rule is labelled not_a_control, or a capped label copy is returned
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Before figure_kind, the 31 figure_caption rows included real controls (123671 '4.4 Where a setback applies, buildings are to provide...'); re-judged: 23 left not_a_control.
falsifiable_check.external_authority: Production after --apply --ids (53 rows): served totals exact 15,095 / recovered 1,425 / not_a_control 33 / unconfirmed 3,074.
